summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by AstraZeneca PLC reporting its total voting rights as of 31 May 2026 under UK DTR 5.6.1. The filing states an issued share capital of 1,551,009,750 ordinary shares (US$0.25 each) with no treasury shares, giving a total voting rights denominator of 1,551,009,750. There is no transaction, no special situation event, and no change of control or strategy. The filing is purely informational for shareholders to calculate notification thresholds. No deal terms, premium, or advisory details apply.
